explanation: When a business collects a name, phone number, or medical information, it gains the ability to affect a person. Privacy sets limits on that ability: what may be known, why the information is used, who receives it, and how a person can influence what happens to their data. A customer does not give up privacy simply by buying a product.

A Data Protection Officer (DPO) helps an organization comply with the law, provides guidance, reviews practices, and raises concerns. An information security manager protects systems. A lawyer provides legal services within the law. Their work overlaps, but the roles are distinct. You can study privacy without being a lawyer, while still needing to demonstrate deep knowledge and experience or education appropriate to the organization.

This course builds three abilities: reading a legal rule in plain language, connecting it to a real system, and creating evidence of work completed. The quizzes are learning exercises. Finishing the course is neither a government license nor a determination that you are qualified for every organization.
legal: Mandatory requirement • Sections 17B1–17B3: assess the duty to appoint a DPO, the officer’s duties, and the qualification requirements separately.
Authority position • Training alone is not mandatory and does not, by itself, demonstrate deep knowledge.
Working method • In each exercise, distinguish facts, binding rules, recommendations, and open questions.

case.story: A shop owner asks you to add a document to the website and announce that you are the shop’s DPO.
case.resolution: First establish what the shop does, whether a DPO must be appointed, whether you are qualified, and the scope of the work. A website document does not replace an action plan.

actions: Write down what you would offer: a technical review, implementation, training, or a DPO appointment.
Choose a fictional system to follow throughout the course.
Save your progress and learning notes on this device, and export a backup occasionally.
first_lesson.trap: A completion certificate, impressive title, or quiz score does not prove that an organization complies with the law.
first_lesson.exercise: In two lines, explain to a business owner how privacy work helps beyond adding a document to a website.
first_lesson.model: The work checks what data is collected and where it goes, reduces unnecessary uses, and organizes permissions and responses to people’s requests. The evidence lies in processes and checks, not in a document alone.

questions.prompt: What is the main result of professional privacy work?
options: A process that protects people and is documented with evidence
A single document that grants immunity
A certificate that replaces assessing the organization
questions.why: Privacy requires ongoing management of information, compliance, and oversight.

questions.prompt: What does finishing this course demonstrate?
options: An official license from the authority
Automatic qualification for every DPO role
questions.why: The law considers knowledge and skills in the context of the organization, not merely completion of this course.

first_lesson.simple: Imagine that customer data is a key to their home: receiving the key for one purpose does not give you permission to use it for everything.
